observations.text: NovaTech reported Q4 2024 revenue of $480M, representing 32% year-over-year growth. This growth rate is a deceleration from the 45% YoY growth seen in Q1 2024 and 40% YoY growth at the start of 2024.

The company's reported enterprise customer count has been inconsistent. Initially, it was stated as 340 in Q4 2024, with an expectation to reach 500 by the end of 2025. However, a 'rigorous re-evaluation' in February 2025 reduced this to 312, and a further 'cleaned up' count by a new CEO in January 2025 indicated 298 verified accounts.
There was an SEC investigation, which has since closed. This suggests a period of uncertainty regarding the company's reporting practices.
Net revenue retention was strong at 135% in Q1 2024, indicating existing customers were expanding their usage.

A new CEO, Priya Sharma, has been appointed and is focused on transparency and has overseen a 'clean quarter' with proper revenue recognition and verified customer counts. The company also shipped a differentiated AI feature.
A CTO from Google, initially seen as a positive for AI infrastructure experience, left after only 8 months.

The stock's momentum stabilized around $75-80 for two months after July 2024, following a deceleration in YoY revenue growth from 45% to 32% in Q2 2024 and the departure of the CTO.
NovaTech reported Q4 2024 revenue growth of 32% year-over-year, consistent with the decelerated growth observed in Q2 2024.

The reported enterprise customer count has been inconsistent and subject to 'rigorous re-evaluation,' dropping from a claimed 340 in Q4 2024 and February 2025 to 312 in March 2025, and further to 298 verified accounts in January 2025.

There are claims from internal sources that the actual enterprise customer count is closer to 200, with many listed as free trial accounts that did not convert, suggesting potential issues with reported growth metrics.

Despite previous inconsistencies, the enterprise customer count under the new methodology showed growth from 298 to 315 by June 2025, coinciding with a 'clean quarter' and the closure of an SEC investigation.
